[!dolt] skip
# Test bd status and bd stats alias
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'First issue' --description 'Open issue' --json
extractid FIRST
bd create 'Second issue' --description 'Will close' --json
extractid SECOND
bd close $SECOND --reason Done

bd status
stdout 'Total Issues:'
stdout 'Open:'
stdout 'Closed:'

bd stats --json
jq '.summary.total_issues'
stdout '^2$'
jq '.summary.open_issues'
stdout '^1$'
jq '.summary.closed_issues'
stdout '^1$'
